title: Tofu: Interconnect for the K computer
version: Fujitsu Scientific & Technical Journal 48(3), pp. 280–285, July 2012

passages.note: Fujitsu describes the dedicated controller, four network interfaces, six-dimensional organization and three-dimensional rank mapping developed for K.

lineage: The original Fujitsu journal article was uploaded to ResearchGate by coauthor Toshiyuki Shimizu.
